title: watch becomes a dashboard: stable rows, pipeline per tick, health verdict, needs-you first
description:
`ticfac watch` becomes a dashboard, not a feed. Operator, 2026-09-28: "the long list in watch becomes unwieldy. I had in mind more of a dashboard type ui, where more things are stable and i track progress … think of a world class status."

A world-class status answers, in order: does anything need me? is it healthy? how far along is it? Everything else is drill-in. Borrowed from: Tilt/k9s/btop (stable resource table, rows never move, state by colour), GitHub Actions/Buildkite (per-job stage pipeline), Temporal/Argo (durable run with a clear phase; retries folded into history, not alarms), Devin/Copilot agent (per-agent card: current action, progress), Vercel/Linear (calm headline; "nothing needs you" when true).

Target layout (spec — fits one screen; exact glyphs negotiable):

```
 6in  ticfac takeover of what ticks drops                      local · herdr · alive
 ███████████████████░░░░  5/6 ticks · 12h24m · ETA ~40m        ● healthy (recovered: net ×14, sleep 41m)
 plan ✓  waves ✓  review ✓  close-out ◐  ci ◐  merge ○          needs you: nothing

 TICK  WHAT                              TIER      PIPELINE                         TIME   ATTEMPTS
 060   cloud worker early-exit nudge     strong    claim ▸ work ▸ gate ▸ merged ✓   49m    1
 46x   port sandbox verbs to ticfac      frontier  claim ▸ work ▸ gate ▸ merged ✓   1h39m  2 ⤴
 v7z   close out phase 7                 closeout  claim ▸ work ▸ ●ci ▸ …           1h12m  2
   └ 823  repair: tk 0.32 width tests    frontier  claim ▸ work ▸ gate ▸ merged ✓   2h03m  2 ⤴

 WORKERS                                     ACTIVITY (10m)    LAST
 v7z  claude opus · herdr pane tick-v7z-a11  ▁▃▅█▇▅▃▁▂▅        ran go test ./internal/reconcile (42s ago)

 CI #98 go ◐ 6m · go race ✓ · ts ✓ · contracts ✓           cost  Workers AI $0.41 · claude (Max) not metered
 ─ recent ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 19:12 v7z  gate passed on 9a1c…      19:04 fold  resolved 2 conflicts      [e] events  [enter] tick
```

Rules:
1. Rows never move: one row per tick in plan order, children indented under their parent; the PIPELINE cell fills left to right (claim ▸ work ▸ gate ▸ merged/closed; role ticks show their own stages).
2. Attention first and quiet when empty: "needs you: nothing" dim; a hold/held question/remedy shows in the header with the one command that clears it.
3. Health as a verdict, not raw counters: "healthy (recovered: …)" / "degraded: …" / "stopped: …"; raw counts behind a key.
4. ETA from remaining ticks × median tick time, shown as "~", hidden until a few ticks closed.
5. Workers show liveness from wv2's activity signals: activity sparkline + last tool action + time on tick; stuck nudges visible.
6. The event feed shrinks to a two-line tail; `e` opens the full feed, `enter` opens a tick: attempts (tier, verdict, why), report summary, gate evidence, diff stats, findings.
7. Honest cost: metered where measured (Workers AI via gateway logs), "not metered" where not (local claude on Max, local pi/GLM if unmeasured) — never a fabricated $0.00.
8. One status model (6dh's `ticfac status --json`), two renderers: this TUI and the phone page (i1r) — they cannot disagree.
Also fold in the first-use bugs: "remote retrys" typo; "v7z rejected x" must show reason and next step.

Deliverables: (a) status-model extensions (per-tick pipeline stage, health verdict, ETA, per-worker activity, cost with measured/unmeasured, attention list) with contract + tests; (b) the watch dashboard renderer (fixed layout, resize-aware, drill-in keys, works in herdr panes and plain terminals, degrades gracefully for narrow widths and non-TTY); (c) the bare `ticfac` overview adopts the same per-run headline; (d) phone page renders the same model; (e) z7w's Bombadil properties target this layout (rows never reorder; needs-you never empty while a hold exists; never $0.00 for unmetered spend; first frame within its bound).
Candidate: the first epic run in the cloud once dm6 (GitHub App access) lands.

acceptance_criteria: [A1] ticfac watch epic-<id> renders the fixed layout: header (progress bar, ticks n/m, elapsed, ETA, health verdict, phase bar, needs-you), a tick table whose rows never reorder with a per-tick pipeline cell, a workers panel with activity, CI and cost lines, and a two-line event tail; [A2] a held run shows the hold and its clearing command in the header; nothing-needs-you is shown when true; [A3] enter on a tick shows attempts with tier, verdict and reason, report summary, gate evidence, diff stats and findings; e opens the full feed; [A4] cost shows metered spend and says 'not metered' for unmeasured spend, never $0.00; [A5] ticfac status --json carries every field the dashboard renders (contract + tests) and the phone page renders the same model; [A6] z7w's Bombadil properties for this layout pass in CI
